scope: Explicit frozen manifest of available session ZIPs, original retail ZIP, conversation exports and selected local provenance/test files; NOT all historic uploads, all GitHub branches or user computer.
caveats: Signatures/extensions only identify candidates, not origin or build.
Synthetic test dumps are not runtime game evidence.
A log referring to a local dump is not the dump itself.
Conversation claims are not original binary artifacts.
Absence from available scope does not prove nonexistence on user machine or elsewhere.
